faqs.title: What is a Popcorn Tile?
faqs.body:
• Popcorn is a special tile type unlocked at level 1111.
  • The goal is to create popcorn by merging tiles next to the popcorn machine and then collect all the popcorn boxes.
  • The popcorn machine displays the number of tiles required to create the popcorn.
  • Once the required number of tiles is merged, the popcorn machine disappears and 3 random popcorn boxes are placed on the board.
  • You can merge tiles anywhere on the board to create the popcorn.
  • After the popcorn is created, merge next to a popcorn box to collect it.

faqs.title: How do I cancel my accidental purchase?
faqs.body:
Android: If you are an Android user, kindly send us a screenshot of your Google Purchase Receipt. This will enable us to promptly investigate and process a refund.

iOS: If you are playing our game on an Apple device, please be informed that we are unable to process refunds directly, as the Apple Store manages all transactions. In this event, we kindly ask you to reach out to Apple Support for assistance in initiating the refund process.

To prevent unintentional or unauthorized future purchases, we recommend visiting the following links to learn how to set restrictions on your device:

  • Android
  • iOS

Implementing these restrictions add an extra layer of security and control over your in-app purchases, ensuring a more secure and enjoyable gaming experience.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter. If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our support team.

faqs.title: I'm Colorblind and have difficulty sorting the colors.
faqs.body:
You can play our colorblind mode that's designed to ease the color difficulty. Please follow these simple steps:

1- Head to the main menu of the game.

2- Tap on the settings icon at the top right corner of the screen.

3- In the settings panel, you will see the colorblind toggle button, turn it on.

faqs.title: Can I Remove Ads/No Ads in the game?
faqs.body:
It's possible to disable full screen ad interruptions during gameplay (also known as interstitial ads) with a No Ads item! If you haven't purchased this item in the past, you can purchase this consumable item to disable interstitial ads for 30 days. If your time runs out, you can purchase the item again to disable interstitial ads for another 30 days.

Please note that banner ads and rewarded videos cannot be removed. You will always have the option to watch advertisements to receive extra rewards!

The Remove-Ads can be found in your main menu screen and the Remove Ads bundle in the store. 


 

Update:

  • Before Version 2.0.58 - No Ads is permanent
  • Version 2.0.58 - Before Version 4.8.30 - No Ads is a 30 days consumable
  • Version 4.8.30 - Present - No Ads is permanent

 

Notice:

  • Purchased permanent No Ads would remain intact even with updates.
  • Purchased 30 days No Ads would not transition to a permanent No Ads when changes occur.

faqs.title: Game Freezing / Crashing / Not Loading
faqs.body:
If you’re experiencing issues while playing, please try the following troubleshooting steps:

  • Ensure the game is up to date - Make sure you’re running the latest version
  • Clear your cache - Clearing cached data can help fix loading, freezing, or performance issues.
  • Restart your device - Rebooting your device helps refresh system processes and can resolve temporary issues affecting gameplay.
  • Check your connection - Make sure you’re connected to a strong Wi-Fi or mobile data signal. Try switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data to see if the issue improves.
If you are still running into problems or still require assistance after doing this, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We'll be happy to investigate further and assist.

faqs.title: What is a Collection?
faqs.body:
Collections are a special, time-limited feature where you can gather cards through chests and events.

  • You'll unlock the Collections feature after completing level 71.
  • Each collection lasts for two months, giving you plenty of time to collect and enjoy!
  • You can access collections by pressing on the cards icon on the bottom right.

popular_articles.title: What is a Candy tile?
popular_articles.body:
• Candy is a special tile type unlocked at level 1153.
  • The objective is to collect candy by making merges next to the candy machine.
  • Each time you merge beside the machine, a candy is produced and collected. As the candy is consumed, the machine’s stick shortens, freeing up more space on the board.
  • When the stick is completely used up, the candy machine disappears.

popular_articles.title: What is a Mystery Card?
popular_articles.body:
• Mystery Cards are special, event-exclusive cards you can only earn by winning certain events (e.g., Piñata Smash, Weekly Quest, Donut Craze, Sticker Hunt).
  • To collect them, join, play, and win the eligible event—rewards are granted on victory.
  • Mystery Cards do not drop from card packs or regular gameplay; they’re event-only.
  • Every Mystery Card is a 5-star, Ultra Rare card.

  • Merging stacks next to the Rabbit will clear it once the carrot is collected.

popular_articles.title: What is the HexaSort Official Store?
popular_articles.body:
What is the HexaSort Official Store?

  • The HexaSort Official Store is a new way to buy coins, bundles, and offers directly inside the game.
  • It is powered by AppCharge, a secure web-based checkout, instead of the App Store or Google Play.
  • Buying through the Official Store unlocks better deals, including up to 10% off on eligible items.

What is Buy Direct?

  • Buy Direct is a toggle that lets you choose where your in-game purchases are processed.
  • When ON, your purchases go through the HexaSort Official Store (AppCharge).
  • When OFF, your purchases go through the regular App Store / Google Play flow.
  • The toggle is always optional — you can switch back at any time.

Where do I find the Buy Direct toggle?

  • You can switch Buy Direct on or off from two places:
    • Settings menu → look for BUY DIRECT alongside Sounds, Notifications, Haptics, Game Boost, etc.
    • The Switch to AppCharge pop-up that appears when you are in the shop
  • Tap GOT IT! on the pop-up to apply your choice.

How do I make a purchase through the Official Store?

  • Tap any offer in the Shop while Buy Direct is ON (or pick the Official Store option from the Switch to AppCharge pop-up).
  • You will be taken to the AppCharge checkout page, which shows:
    • The item name and price
    • Your email
    • Your saved payment methods (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) or google pay/apple pay
  • Tap Pay to complete your purchase.
  • Once payment is processed, tap Return to game to head back to HexaSort with your reward delivered!

Is paying through the Official Store safe?

  • Yes! AppCharge is a secure third-party payment processor that handles your card information.
  • HexaSort does not see or store your payment details.
  • You can find AppCharge's Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Support links at the bottom of the checkout page.

I bought something through the Official Store but did not receive it?

  • If your purchase was completed but you have not received your reward, follow these steps:
    • Tap on the Restore Purchases button found in the Settings menu.
    • If the Restore Purchases button does not fix the issue, please delete the game and reinstall it (without deleting your account).
    • In case that does not work either, please contact in-game chat support with the purchase receipt (found in your email) mentioning:
      • Order Number
      • Date
      • Contents of Purchase

popular_articles.title: How do I play Hexa Sort?
popular_articles.body:
• In order to complete a level, you need to place tiles to sort and merge them
  • You have to place similar colored hex tiles next to each other on the board to sort and stack them.
  • Once you have 10 tiles in a stack the stack will merge and pop
  • Each level gives you a new goal to achieve.
  • You must collect the given number of hex tiles to pass the level.
  • Place the same-colored tiles together and watch them stack, sort, and merge satisfyingly. The collected tiles will allow you to color & build a beautiful world after completing each level.

popular_articles.title: How do I transfer my Progress to another device?
popular_articles.body:
Account syncing is now available for app version 4.3.02 and above.

 

Creating a Save

  • To create your save, please access your Settings Menu (the gear icon at the top right), select "Save Progress" and select either Facebook\Apple or Facebook\Google (depending on your device you are logged into).

 

Transferring the progress to a new device

  • On your old device, open the game and go to Settings → Account.
      • Sync your progress with Facebook, Google, or Apple.
    1. On your new device, install and open the game.
      • Go to Settings → Account and log in with the same provider you used on the old device.

    Note: If you haven’t synced your account with Facebook, Google, or Apple, your progress will only be stored locally and cannot be transferred to another device.
